observations.title: Cycle a new villager's offers
observations.player_action: Open trading with a villager that has never been traded with and use the cycle button or documented C binding.
observations.outcome: Offers can be rerolled without repeatedly replacing its workstation or waiting for working hours.
conditions: A villager already traded with is excluded; this extends the native trading interface.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.
